original.text: anyonyapakṣapratipakṣabhāvād yathā pare matsariṇaḥ pravādāḥ / nayān aśeṣān aviśeṣam icchan na pakṣapātī samayas tathā te
original.edition: recalled by the unit author (wording believed standard; to be checked against an edition)

paraphrase: As the other doctrines are jealous of one another, standing as thesis and counter-thesis, your doctrine, which accepts all standpoints without distinction, is not partisan.
notes: Verse number recalled, not checked; the content is the unit author's recollection (skeleton).

paraphrase: 'There is a maker of the world; he is one, all-pervading, independent and eternal' — such obstinate fancies belong to those whose teacher you are not.
